scorecard.assessment: Internal shape is strongly consistent with 37 fitted SUP/repeat distances; they cannot independently validate the later rigid global rotation.
Independent shell/face checks are excellent-to-good; no Room C-wide scale pattern.
Five active field rechecks fit closely; they were inputs to v0.2, so independent count remains zero.
Known 42 mm opposing-width conflict remains under the human rectangular constraint; no new inconsistency.
Both long checks are good: 9019 span is 0.68% short and D4→A5 is within 3 mm of the range on the accepted object layer.
Single D3-normal check is in Review at 1.11%; exact physical ray bearing remains uncertain.
Local object-layer concerns remain: known CP1 RC-04 conflict and coherent D4→CP2 model-long rays.

systematicPatternAnalysis.broadScale: Not indicated. Room A internal SUP distances, Room C independent closures and Room B rechecks do not share a common percentage bias; all transforms are rigid and scale 1.

byRoom.roomA: All 37 scalar SUP/repeat inputs remain within 0.534% of their readings; this validates internal shape but is not independent of the Room A fit.
byRoom.roomC: VALID-RC-01/02 and the D3–D4 object-edge check are good or excellent; no shell-wide Room C displacement pattern.
byRoom.roomB: The five active rechecks have median absolute residual 5.117 mm and worst 0.783%; SUP-065 is the isolated older outlier.
byRoom.wc: Residuals are symmetric around the imposed 1662.69 mm width because the two measured widths conflict by 42 mm; this is known, not a newly detected transform error.

byDoorway.D2: The 9019 mm A/C span is good (0.68% short). The rigid Room A rotation barely changed it, so it supports placement tolerance but does not uniquely validate rotation.
byDoorway.D3: The 3726 mm span is 1.11% short under the D3-normal assumption. Face layers are named correctly; unrecorded ray bearing remains the principal ambiguity.
byDoorway.D4: D4→A5 is compatible, while both D4→CP2 rays are long. That split implicates CP2 endpoint/layer interpretation rather than a general D4 station error.
byDoorway.D5: Room B/WC casing and cross-tie evidence has no new outlier beyond the known rectangular-WC compromise.

cp2Diagnosis.translatedAsWhole: Conditionally plausible from the two D4 rays alone: their midpoint discrepancies are similar. It is not supported unconditionally because RC-19 fixes CP2-FR→PI3 to -4 mm.
cp2Diagnosis.depthIncorrect: Not supported. Direct 536 mm body depth is reproduced, and the front/rear D4 excesses are similar rather than divergent.
cp2Diagnosis.widthIncorrect: Not supported. Direct 708 mm body width is reproduced exactly; the separate inherited 755 mm footprint still has 27 mm unallocated casing/gap detail.
cp2Diagnosis.d4InterpretationMismatch: Plausible. Frozen v1.3 has inherited D4-CL at x=3048.67 and accepted D4-OUTER-L at x=3067.00, an 18.33 mm layer/station split.
cp2Diagnosis.casingFootprintMismatch: Most strongly supported documentation issue. CP2-FR exists both as an inherited outer reference and a separate body-front-right point; CP2-CR is not instantiated at all.
cp2Diagnosis.conclusion: The evidence does not justify moving CP2. Confirm endpoint layers first. If body endpoints are confirmed, retain a medium-confidence local CP2/D4 relative-position concern for later review.

outlierShortlist.feature: CP1 body-right placement relative to PO1
outlierShortlist.finding: Model is 265.70 mm versus 225 mm, +40.70 mm (+18.09%).
outlierShortlist.likelyCause: Known object-layer conflict introduced when the direct 1285 mm CP1 body width replaced the provisional CP1-FR station; body edge versus inherited casing/shell reference is the leading explanation.
outlierShortlist.confidence: High that the documented conflict exists; medium on physical cause.
outlierShortlist.smallestUsefulAction: First confirm the original RC-04 contact surfaces from notes/photo. Only if still unclear, recheck CP1 body-right to PO1 once; no shell survey programme.

outlierShortlist.finding: Body-layer models are long by 45.829–59.829 mm at the front and 47.196–67.196 mm at the rear.
outlierShortlist.likelyCause: A coherent local endpoint/layer mismatch is more likely than independent noise. CP2 width and depth match direct dimensions, and corrected RC-19 is only -4 mm, so depth/width error is not supported. If the field contacts are confirmed as body corners, the paired rays instead resemble a roughly 50–60 mm CP2/D4 relative translation.
outlierShortlist.confidence: Medium; CP2-CR is absent from frozen v1.3 and the front name also spans footprint/body layers.
outlierShortlist.smallestUsefulAction: No new distance initially: annotate/confirm whether both shots touched D4-OUTER-L and CP2 body front/back right. If confirmed and a numeric recheck is still required, repeat only the easier front-right shot.

outlierShortlist.finding: Model is 862.91 mm versus 888 mm, -25.09 mm (-2.83%).
outlierShortlist.likelyCause: Isolated older casing/corner endpoint or layer discrepancy; the five later Room B rechecks do not show a matching shell displacement.
outlierShortlist.confidence: Medium that it is an isolated evidence-layer issue; low that it indicates shell failure.
outlierShortlist.smallestUsefulAction: None before 2D sign-off unless this short diagonal is construction-critical.

outlierShortlist.feature: WC opposing widths under rectangular constraint
outlierShortlist.finding: The active 1643/1685 mm widths differ by 42 mm; the frozen 1662.69 mm rectangle splits that conflict and the diagonal SUP-072 is +20.83 mm (+1.06%).
outlierShortlist.likelyCause: Known field-face/room non-ideal conflict intentionally overridden by the human architectural rectangle.
outlierShortlist.smallestUsefulAction: None for pre-final 2D validation; revisit only at construction-detail stage if exact WC finishes matter.
